name: dsh-kb-sync
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: pull your DeepSeek web conversations into a local knowledge base (markdown + JSONL + catalog) with in-plugin search, orchestrate a sync/integrity command you already own from a same-origin control page, and run the pipeline's judgement step in process through the host llm service (one stream, JSON validated before anything lands).

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/deepseek.js && node --check lib/export.js && node --check lib/page.js && node --check lib/pipeline.js && node --check lib/process.js && node --check lib/store.js && node --check tools/pipeline/recon-update.mjs && node --check tools/pipeline/update-from-api.mjs && node --input-type=module -e "await import('./lib/index.js'); console.log('import ok')"
